title: Close out foundations epic: retro + plan Phase 1
description: Retro on the foundations run; fold learnings into .tick/learnings.md; then plan the Phase 1 epic (ko8) against what deploy/setup/auth actually look like in practice.
notes: 2026-08-19 15:30 - When planning Phase 1 (ko8), fold in UC1b + D21/D22 from docs/design/cloud-factory.md — the operator command surface (tk cloud run/stop/status, --queue) is Phase 1 scope, not a later addition: a cloud run you cannot stop or inspect is not shippable. Key constraints to carry into the ticks: stop is enforced at the Workflow/gateway-token layer (survives a wedged orchestrator), there is deliberately NO mid-run mutation channel (steering is stop -> edit -> restart via reconcile), and the tracker is read at run start only.
